snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
“Forgive me for all I’ve done” Experience the epic conclusion. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. #DuneMovie#FilmedforIMAX

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

GODZILLA MINUS ZERO picks up in 1949, two years after the tumultuous events of Godzilla Minus One, and continues the story of the Shikishima family as they face an all-new calamity.

Fans can look forward to seeing Godzilla presented to all new terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.

snippet.title: DON'T TURN ON THE LIGHT (Kinger's Song) Feat. Sean Chiplock from The Amazing Digital Circus
snippet.description:
STREAM #DontTurnOnTheLight ON SPOTIFY: https://open.spotify.com/album/3EPV6tUCbI172SvGUTlRW3?si=K89pYciRQiefF0Itwe8kYw

AND EVERYWHERE ELSE: https://ffm.to/kinger

MORE ORIGINAL MUSIC HERE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrMjrvz5hyc&list=PLv1P-6YxEm6AgF6yiKtydFevNQV4RxKn4&index=1

Another stellar video from the brilliant animation team at Giddy Goat Studios!! HUGE thanks to Sean for powering through this tongue-twister of a song! We wanted to capture the duality of Kinger's personality and create a lyrical and instrumental contrast between the chaos of his mind when the lights are on, and the reflective state he enters when the lights are off. Kinger is definitely one of my favorite characters from TADC, and we really hope we did his story justice!

SONG CREDITS:
Written by Gabe & Nate brown (Black Gryph0n & Baasik)
Produced by Nate Brown (Baasik): https://www.youtube.com/user/Baasikmusic

FEATURING:
Sean Chiplock (as Kinger): https://www.instagram.com/schiplock/
Gabriel Brown (as Kinger's inner voice): https://www.instagram.com/BlackGryph0n/

VIDEO CREDITS:

Claire M Corlett - Producer & Director
Katie Nelson - Producer & Director

Gabby Gillespie - 3D Animator
Bordin Sriwattana - 3D Animator
Logan McCloud - 3D Animator
Marah Wessendorf - 3D Animator

Michaela Pulizos - Storyboard Artist

Derek Gomen - Lighting & Rendering Artist

ZayJax - Character Rigs

Environment Assets by https://tadcworldpack.crd.co/ 


-- --- ---- ----- Lyrics ----- ---- --- --

Wait... where am I?
What is this? *gasp*
Is that a microphone?

Something’s got control of me
That I can not explain
It’s like a billion bumble bees
Are buzzing in my brain

I think I should be worried
And I really don’t know why
But I feel it in my body
And I feel it in my mind

Kind of like I’ve been edited
By the thoughts inside my head
And I really wish I could run from it
But it’s running me instead

It’s like somebody’s flushing
My higher functions down the drain
I would think I’m going crazy
If I wasn’t so insane

Darkness...
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember her...
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

WAIT! Don’t turn on the light!
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the light
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the...

I feel like I should know this place
I’ve seen it all before
But the only place I recognize
Is in my pillow fort

I wish I could remember
What I came out here to do
But how’s that even possible
When I can’t remember you

I hear 10,000 voices
And they’re all talking super loud
But at least I’m not hallucinating
Wait, is that a cow?

Feels like all my thoughts are leaking
Out of little holes inside my mind
And I haven’t had a memory
Since nineteen-something-nine

Darkness...
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember her...
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

WAIT! Don’t turn on the light!
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the light
(Light light light light light)
Don’t turn on the...

Sometimes I see things
A little more clearly
And though it’s all fleeting
I know I’m still me

I’m still here because she
Lives in my memory
And that makes me believe that
One day I’ll be free from the

Darkness
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember her
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

Darkness
Picking up the pieces
Drowning out the light
I suddenly remember
Her
Everything about her
Makes me feel alive

- -- --- ---- ----- END ----- ---- --- -- -


Hello DDR’s (dedicated description readers)

Hasn't been too long this time, huh?! Let's see, what's happened since the last time we spoke... I got sick and lost my voice (which SUCKS because I have a LOT of stuff I need to record and I am not very patient, but it has given me a good excuse to work on my hobbies like flying and upgrading my plane, so that's been nice).

Claire turned 27 yesterday (HAPPY BIRTHDAY CLAIRE!!) We went shopping all day, then had beignets and opened presents with my family, so that was fun!

Oh yeah, and the Insane music video got taken down by Amazon! As frustrating as that was, we've actually been able to make some pretty good headway on that situation (big thanks to Viv and the SpindleHorse team for being so helpful and supportive of fan content)! I have high hopes we'll get the video back up soon, fingers crossed!

In the meantime, feel free to watch one of the many reuploads on other people's channels. That animation is far too good to be buried!!

Ok, I think that's it. Thank you all! Your love and support mean the world to us!

~Gabe

snippet.title: MANHUNTER: THE FINAL CUT | Official Trailer | STUDIOCANAL
snippet.description:
The film that redefined the modern thriller. 40 years on, Michael Mann’s pulsating, cutting-edge MANHUNTER: THE FINAL CUT returns to cinemas in a brand new breathtaking 4K restoration supervised by Michael Mann. Coming to the US via Rialto Pictures on July 24th and StudioCanal UK on September 25th, with further international releases this fall. 

#manhunter #michaelmann #4k 

A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert - the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). 

The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris’s famed crime novels and benefits from the filmmaker’s typically striking visuals as well as a top notch supporting cast including Tom Noonan as Francis Dolarhyde - the hunted killer known as the Red Dragon or the "Tooth Fairy" - along with three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen (The Contender, 2000) as his blind love interest.

Find out more at http://www.studiocanal.com 🎥

STUDIOCANAL is Europe’s leading movie & television studio with one of the world’s largest film libraries. The official STUDIOCANAL YouTube channel showcases the latest trailers for upcoming releases + clips and exclusive content from our extensive and celebrated library. Enjoy - and subscribe for more!

snippet.title: Alphaville - Forever Young (Sub. Español + Lyrics)
snippet.description:
👤 Artista | Alphaville
💿 Canción | Forever Young
📅 Fecha de Lanzamiento | 09/07/2009
🔊 Géneros Musicales | Pop

✨ Acerca de la Canción:
"Forever Young" de Alphaville es un himno del synth-pop que reflexiona sobre la juventud, el paso del tiempo y el deseo de vivir intensamente. Con una letra nostálgica y esperanzadora, la canción transmite el anhelo de permanecer joven para siempre mientras invita a valorar cada momento de la vida.

📲 Sígue a "Alphaville" en:
▶️ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCObmDvjXCn62yi-aOuGP5Yg

⭐ Encuéntrame en Redes:
🔗 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jostland_/
🌐 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/josstland/
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@iamjostland
📬 Contacto Directo por Instagram: @jostland_

🎶 [ Letra / Lyrics ] 🎶

[Verse 1]
Let's dance in style, let's dance for a while
Heaven can wait, we're only watching the skies
Hoping for the best but expecting the worst
Are you gonna drop the bomb or not?
Let us die young or let us live forever
We don't have the power but we never say never
Sitting in a sandpit, life is a short trip
The music's for the sad man

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you imagine when this race is won?
Turn our golden faces into the sun
Praising our leaders, we're getting in tune
The music's played by the, the mad man

[Chorus]
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever, and ever
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever young

[Verse 2]
Some are like water, some are like the heat
Some are a melody and some are the beat
Sooner or later, they all will be gone
Why don't they stay young?
It's so hard to get old without a cause
I don't want to perish like a fading horse
Youth's like diamonds in the sun
And diamonds are forever

[Pre-Chorus]
So many adventures couldn't happen today
So many songs we forgot to play
So many dreams swinging out of the blue
We'll let them come true

[Chorus]
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever, and ever
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever, and ever

[Outro]
Forever young, I wanna be forever young
Do you really want to live forever? (Forever)

#Alphaville #ForeverYoung

snippet.title: T.M.Revolution - HOT LIMIT / THE FIRST TAKE
snippet.description:
「THE FIRST TAKE」は、一発撮りのパフォーマンスを鮮明に切り取るYouTubeチャンネル。

第685回は、今年デビュー30周年を迎えたT.M.Revolutionが約2年半振りに登場。
今回披露するのは、世代を超えて幅広い層に愛される日本の夏のアンセム「HOT LIMIT」。
1998年にリリースされ、現在まで28年間色褪せることなく支持され続けている本楽曲を、
当時を忠実に再現した大胆で刺激的な衣装と共に、T.M.Revolutionの歌唱力が光る特別な一発撮りにてパフォーマンス。

STREAMING & DOWNLOAD：https://erj.lnk.to/B1en3v
Music Video：https://youtu.be/vBmU5v2EyxM

■T.M.Revolution OFFICIAL
Official HP: https://www.tm-revolution.com/
X:  https://x.com/TMR15
Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/takanori9nishikawa/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@tmrevolutionSMEJ

■THE FIRST TAKE　OFFICIAL  
Web Site: https://www.thefirsttake.jp/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the_firsttake/
X: https://twitter.com/The_FirstTake
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@the_first_take

■RULES
白いスタジオに置かれた一本のマイク。 
ここでのルールはただ一つ。
一発撮りのパフォーマンスをすること。 

A microphone and a white studio.
And 1 rule.
You’ve got 1 TAKE.

■STATEMENT
一発撮りで切りとる。
今という時間と、
今しか出せない音を。

THE FIRST TAKE
この瞬間は、二度とない。

CAPTURE THE TAKE.
THIS MOMENT.
THIS SOUND.

THE FIRST TAKE
IT ONLY HAPPENS ONCE.


Episode 685 marks the return of T.M.Revolution—celebrating the 30th anniversary of his debut this year—for his first appearance in two years.
He will perform “HOT LIMIT,” a Japanese summer anthem beloved across generations.
Enjoy the one-shot performance of a song that has stood the test of time for 28 years, brought to life by T.M.Revolution’s awe-inspiring vocals, along with his iconic, bold outfit —a faithful recreation of the original look.

The Last Dinner Party - 'Knocking at the Sky' lyrics:

Standing on the windowsill
Walking in your sleep
On the streets sirens sang
For you to take the leap

Thought that you were Icarus
Or at least that you were Greek
To the people down below
You’re just another freak

I would give my eyes away just to be the light
I’d burn off my fingerprints, start a brand new life
I would trade my innocence, choke upon my pride
You can find me every night
Knocking at the sky

Singing La La La La
Singing la La La La
Singing la La La La
Singing la La La La

Women wept when you were gone
Lay naked on the shore
A hero’s death in chiffon trenches
Who could ask for more?

And you would seek the mountains
Or the moon where snow is born
To gaze upon the cobra
Or Athena in soft core

I would give my eyes away just to be the light
I’d burn off my fingerprints, start a brand new life
I would trade my innocence, choke upon my pride
You can find me every night
Knocking at the sky

Singing La La La La
Singing la La La La
Singing la La La La
Singing la La La La

[spoken]
Honey, there’s a seven-car-pile-up
On the highway to my heart
But if I give you the green light
You promise you’ll never come back
You promise?

Oh, I rue the day I ever left this place
I gave my headshots in to Trashy’s Lingerie
I want my MTV, my grass and my valet
It never rains on me
Oh god I love LA!

La la la la la
La la la la la
(Repeat)

snippet.title: Shermans vs Panthers: Four Days of Hell
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0238

November 4th, 1944. Lt. Raymond E. Fleig of Company A, US Army’s 707th Tank Battalion, leads a platoon of M4A3 Shermans up a treacherous mud trail in the middle of the Hürtgen Forest. He’s been sent on a critical mission, through the quagmire of the deep woodlands, to reinforce the exhausted American GIs of the 28th ‘Bloody Bucket’ Division who are desperately holding the village of Kommerscheidt against a German onslaught. In a brutal four-day battle against an entire Panzer division, Fleig faces off against the mighty Panthers and Panzer IVs, as well as endless waves of German infantry and artillery fire. What follows is a story of heroism, tragedy and the doomed last stand in the Hürtgen Forest.

Sources:

HistoryNet (2006). Battle of Hurtgen Forest: Fight for Schmidt and Kommerscheidt.
MacDonald, Charles B (1963). The Battle of the Hürtgen Forest.
Miller, Edward G. (1995). A Dark and Bloody Ground: The Hürtgen Forest and the Roer River Dams, 1944–1945.
Charles River Editors (2015). The Battle of Hürtgen Forest: The History of the Longest Battle Fought in Germany during World War II.
McNally, Michael (2025). Hürtgen Forest 1944 (1): The US First Army’s Route to the Rhine.
